lines.q: Egyptian embalmers pulled the brain out through the what?
lines.a: The nose! With a long hook. Yes, really.

lines.q: The were in werewolf means what?
lines.a: Man! A werewolf is literally a man wolf.

lines.q: Last one. A black cat crossing your path is lucky in which country?
lines.a: Britain! Not unlucky there at all.
